notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Corridor Monitor that is tapped and attacking.
When the Corridor Monitor token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
